giveitem.description: Gives an item to your inventory using its blueprint path.

params.BlueprintPath: Full blueprint path of the item.
params.ForceBlueprint: If true, gives the blueprint (schematic) instead of the crafted item.

giveitemnum.description: Legacy variant of GiveItem that uses a numeric ID. Numeric IDs are not reliable across game versions, which is why this tool uses blueprint-based GiveItem by default.

params.ForceBlueprint: If true, gives the blueprint instead of the item.

gmsummon.description: Spawns an already-adult creature (or one at a specific level) using its class name.

spawndino.description: Spawns a wild creature in front of you, with fine control over position and level.

summon.description: Spawns a wild base-level creature right at your position.

params.ClassName: Class name of the creature to spawn.

destroywilddinos.description: Destroys all wild creatures on the map (tamed ones are not affected).

teleport.description: Teleports you in the direction you are looking.

teleportplayeridtome.description: Brings a player to your position using their Player ID.

teleporttoplayer.description: Teleports you to a player by name or ID.

params.PlayerName_or_ID: Name or ID of the destination player.

fly.description: Enables free-flight mode for your character.

walk.description: Disables flight mode and returns to normal movement.

ghost.description: Enables ghost mode, letting you pass through objects and terrain.

god.description: Enables invulnerability and immunity to hunger/thirst for your character.

infinitestats.description: Keeps all your stats (health, stamina, weight, etc.) at maximum.

enemyinvisible.description: Makes your character invisible to wild creatures.

params.Enabled: true to enable, false to disable.

forcetame.description: Instantly tames the creature you are aiming at.

destroymytarget.description: Completely destroys the creature or structure you are aiming at.

setplayerpos.description: Places your character at an exact map coordinate.

giveallstructure.description: Gives you admin access over the structure you are aiming at.

giveallDino.description: Transfers ownership of all nearby tamed creatures to you.

givetome.description: Transfers ownership of the creature or structure you are aiming at to you.

addexperience.description: Adds experience to your character (or to the creature you are taming/riding).

params.FromTribeShare: Whether it counts as shared by the tribe.
params.PreventSharingWithTribe: Prevents it from being shared with the tribe.

setplayerstat.description: Sets a specific stat of your character.

params.Stat: Stat name (Health, Stamina, Food, Water, etc.).

settargetdinocolor.description: Changes the color of a specific region of the creature you are aiming at.

params.ColorID: ID of the color to apply.

sdf.description: Short alias of SpawnDino, with the same syntax.

saveworld.description: Forces an immediate save of the server/world state.
